name: Digital Drawing Lab
shortDesc: A graphics-tablet classroom for practicing 2D character and environment design.
content: Equipped with high-specification graphics tablets and professional drawing software, the Digital Drawing Lab serves as the core venue for AGD students to practice digital drawing. It covers practical coursework spanning 2D character design, scene concept art, UI interface icons, illustration, and comic creation.

name: 3D Printing Workshop
shortDesc: FDM / photopolymer resin 3D printer fleet, bringing 3D modeled creations into physical reality.
content: The 3D Printing Workshop is equipped with multiple FDM and photopolymer resin (SLA/DLP) 3D printers. Students can directly 3D print characters and props modeled in ZBrush, Maya, and Blender into physical figurines and props, bridging merchandise design and exhibition applications.

name: Motion Capture Lab
shortDesc: Virtual production studio — realistic scenes shot in real time without post-production.
content:
The Motion Capture Lab is the core hub for cultivating forward-looking digital creation talent for next-generation digital content communication and production. Integrating virtual production technology into the department's existing development framework, it provides a practical instructional environment for shooting realistic scenes in real time on stage without post-production, reconstructing virtual worlds in reality through spatial tracking and light projection techniques.

It supports 3D animation filming, video post-production, visual effects processing, image compositing, motion capture, and more.

Expected Educational Objectives:
● Cultivate students' ability in virtual scene production
● Cultivate students' ability to adjust lighting and objects in virtual scenes in real time
● Nurture forward-looking talent in real-time audiovisual compositing technology
● Nurture talent in integrated applications of animation, multimedia, and game development
● Cultivate students' understanding of dynamic motion tracking and positioning linking physical and virtual cameras

name: Motion-Sensing Interaction Lab
shortDesc: VIVE spatial tracking + treadmill / pneumatic motion simulator / bicycle.
content:
The Motion-Sensing Interaction Lab provides an interactive experience and development environment for motion-sensing games, allowing students to test, learn the motion-sensing game production pipeline, and verify their implementations in real time.

Equipment includes:
● Stationary treadmill
● Pneumatic horizontal motion simulator
● Bicycle
● VIVE spatial room-scale tracking environment

name: Puppet Animation Lab
shortDesc: A stop-motion studio combining physical model-making and hands-on, frame-by-frame animation.
content: The Puppet Animation Lab is a shooting space specially designed for stop-motion animation, equipped with controllable lighting, camera slider tracks, and professional capture software. Here, students complete the entire pipeline from physical model-making and frame-by-frame shooting to post-production compositing, cultivating animation craft and patient observation skills.

name: Merchandise Design Lab
shortDesc: 3D printers, direct-printing equipment, heat transfer, laser cutting — end-to-end anime and game merchandise production.
content:
The Merchandise Design Lab provides the environment and equipment required for anime and game-related merchandise design, empowering students to turn characters and IP into physical products.

Equipment includes:
● 3D printer
● Direct-to-substrate printer
● Heat transfer machine
● Laser cutting machine

name: Virtual Sports Tech-Art Pavilion
shortDesc: Digital innovation venue integrating sports × technology.
content:
The Virtual Sports Tech-Art Pavilion prepares students to create new digital applications and services combining sports and technology. It explores new models for smart indoor sports venues and uses technology to add value to outdoor activities such as mountaineering, road running and cycling.

Educational objectives:
● Build students’ knowledge of sports science
● Develop applications that add value to traditional sports and digital sports content
● Prepare students to innovate in the digital economy through sports and technology
● Develop students’ ability to plan and deliver cross-disciplinary exhibitions and presentations combining sports and technology

name: Audiovisual Post-Production and Independent Media Production Lab
shortDesc: 4 digital studios + 4 recording studios: broadcast anchors, voice actors, scoring, and 3D post-production all in one.
content: The Audiovisual Post-Production and Independent Media Production Lab comprises a total of 4 digital production studios and 4 audio recording suites, cultivating talent in broadcasting, independent media and communication, audio post-production, game sound effects, 3D post-production, animation, film scoring, film and television production, digital learning, radio broadcasting, voice acting, and related fields.

name: Hengshan Creative Base (Digital Technology and Cultural Creativity Workshop)
shortDesc: Maker culture base, DIY × technology cross-disciplinary creation.
content:
The Hengshan Creative Base (H0201 Digital Technology and Cultural Creativity Workshop) is a practical venue for Maker culture. Maker culture is a subculture born out of popular culture, rooted in individuals with unique passions and persistent convictions; makers are passionate about technology, dedicated to hands-on practice, and firmly believe in creating with their own hands.

Maker culture is an extension of DIY culture fused with technological elements, combining punk ideals with anti-consumerism. This workshop provides foundational equipment such as laser cutting, 3D printing, electronics prototyping, and woodworking, encouraging students to engage in cross-disciplinary practice.

name: Multimedia / Games and Online Media Classrooms
shortDesc: Multimedia and game/online media classrooms: from theory to development with game engines.
content: Located on floor B1 of the College of Design, the Multimedia Classroom and Games and Online Media Classroom are the primary venues for AGD daily lectures and game engine practice. Equipped with computer workstations, they enable students to carry out project development, team collaboration, and UI design practice in Unity / Unreal.

name: Esports Professional Classroom
content: Equipped with high-spec gaming rigs and tournament-grade equipment, the Esports Professional Classroom is the main training venue for the esports industry program. Here, students conduct match analysis, live streaming, and tournament planning practice, creating interdisciplinary integration with animation and game design.

name: 三創基地 / Maker Center
shortDesc: 三創 (Creativity, Innovation and Entrepreneurship) Base: an incubator supporting student proposals, prototypes and venture development.
content: The 三創 (Creativity, Innovation and Entrepreneurship) Base is an incubator taking student proposals from prototype development to venture incubation. From IP design, brand planning, and business models to exhibitions and live presentations, students transform their works into entrepreneurial opportunities and connect with industry.
